name: Trailer Fetcher
description: Finds and downloads missing local movie trailers from YouTube via yt-dlp.
overview: Finds and downloads missing local movie trailers from YouTube via yt-dlp.

versions.changelog: Fixed the "0 movies found" library-scoping bug, confirmed via diagnostic logging (1026 movies found server-wide, 0 when scoped to a library known to contain real movies). The fix was hand-building TopParentIds from VirtualFolderInfo.ItemId directly, which does not reliably match what TopParentIds-based filtering expects. Now resolves each configured library via ILibraryManager.GetItemById() and queries via InternalItemsQuery.Parent instead.
